Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-21 ER 3; TFA-92599 AC 6 · “Discharge templates never badge-pre-selected, in either context, always manual”. Mixed: stated part — A badge change pre-selects that badge's template afresh; Discharge is never pre-selected; our part — A hand-picked Discharge not carried over after reopen, a context round-trip, or onto another patient (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S06 A hand-picked Discharge summary is never carried into a fresh pre-selection

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 Default template: the admission-status badge pre-selects the template (New Admission → H&P / SNF admission, Follow-up → SOAP progress / SNF follow-up, Consult → Consult note / SNF consult), and the p … (UAT TC-21; UAT TC-21 step 1 (default template); TFA-92599 AC 6; TFA-92599 rule 4; TFA-92584 AC 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Hospital patient A with badge Follow-up (default), Encounter tab open

When Pick 'Discharge summary' by hand. Change the badge to New Admission. Set it back to Follow-up and pick Discharge again, leave and reopen A. Switch Hospital → Nursing Home → Hospital and reopen A. Pending until seeded: open a second Hospital patient B after picking Discharge on A.

Then The hand pick shows while it is fresh. A badge change pre-selects afresh (New Admission → H&P). On reopen, after the round-trip, and on another patient, Discharge is not the selection and the badge's template is.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): U4 'Discharge is never pre-selected', read strictly: whenever the generation step opens again (reopen, context round-trip, badge change, another patient), Discharge is not the selection unless it was picked during that visit. Q11 may relax s06-reopen / s06-after-roundtrip. …
